description: This file contains setup and configuration functions for the Indian regional module in ERPNext, including custom field creation, permission setup, GST code management, and tax configuration.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup function that calls other setup routines based on conditions.

methods.name: setup_company_independent_fixtures
methods.description: Creates custom fields, property setters, permissions, roles, and other fixtures independent of company.

methods.name: add_hsn_sac_codes
methods.description: Reads HSN and SAC code data from JSON files and creates corresponding GST codes.

methods.name: create_hsn_codes
methods.description: Creates GST HSN code documents from provided data.

methods.name: add_custom_roles_for_reports
methods.description: Creates custom roles for various reports if they do not already exist.

methods.name: add_permissions
methods.description: Sets permissions for GST-related doctypes and roles.

methods.name: add_print_formats
methods.description: Enables specific print formats for GST invoices.

methods.name: make_property_setters
methods.description: Creates property setters for invoice series and voucher types.

methods.name: make_custom_fields
methods.description: Creates custom fields for various doctypes.

methods.name: get_custom_fields
methods.description: Defines custom fields for multiple doctypes related to GST and regional settings.

methods.name: make_fixtures
methods.description: Creates default data fixtures such as salary components and TDS accounts.

methods.name: update_regional_tax_settings
methods.description: Updates GST account settings for a specific country and company.

methods.name: add_accounts_in_gst_settings
methods.description: Adds GST accounts to GST Settings if they are not already present.

methods.name: set_salary_components
methods.description: Defines default salary components for payroll.

methods.name: set_tax_withholding_category
methods.description: Creates tax withholding categories with rates and thresholds.

methods.name: get_tds_details
methods.description: Provides default TDS details for various categories.

methods.name: create_gratuity_rule
methods.description: Creates a standard Indian gratuity rule if it does not exist.

methods.name: update_accounts_settings_for_taxes
methods.description: Configures account settings related to taxes if only one company exists.
